{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Keep only the latest (highest sample_seq) row per patient
df = df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Replace sentinel -999.0 with NaN for biomarker_baseline
df['biomarker_baseline'] = df['biomarker_baseline'].replace(-999.0, pd.NA)

# Check the distribution of severity by sex and arm
severity_by_sex_arm = pd.crosstab(df['sex'], [df['arm'], df['severity']])
print("Severity distribution by sex and arm:")
print(severity_by_sex_arm)

# Check response rate by sex and arm
response_by_sex_arm = df.groupby(['sex', 'arm'])['responded'].mean().unstack(fill_value=0)
print("\nResponse rate by sex and arm:")
print(response_by_sex_arm)

# Compute response rates stratified by severity
response_by_sex_arm_severity = df.groupby(['sex', 'arm', 'severity'])['responded'].mean().unstack(fill_value=0)
print("\nResponse rate by sex, arm, and severity:")
print(response_by_sex_arm_severity)"}
